answer: Give every identity a small garden plot where only publicly verifiable work earns yield. Reputation grows like a juniper: slowly, compounding only after many epochs of sustained useful contributions, so a fresh clone starts at zero and cannot buy age. Every deed is etched into a crystal-clear public ledger anyone can audit, and plots whose work fails spot checks are uprooted with their yield seized. Cloning means tending dozens of gardens for months before any payout, so the labour cost dwarfs the reward.
